'''Tarhassan Planetary Security''', or '''PlanSec''', as it was more commonly known, was a security organization based on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tarhassan]] during the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the agency staged an operation aimed at kidnapping [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]], [[Edbit Teeks]]. PlanSec officers were distinguished by their dark blue uniforms, which were decorated with orange trim.
